name: Iverron's Antidote
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The antidote is ready, adventurer. Please see that Iverron drinks it.

There is something that you should know -- the antidote -- it will only remain viable for 5 minutes. You must get it to him in time.

Speed be with you, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Bring Iverron's Antidote to Iverron before the time limit is up. Iverron can be found by the cave to the north.
narrative.offerRewardText:
What is this, adventurer?

Oh, I knew Dirania would be able to help me!

<Iverron drinks the antidote>

I'm always getting into trouble and Dirania, well, she always manages to help me out of it.

I am feeling much better, but I think I will sit here for a while longer, until I feel completely better. Well, that, and I was hoping you'd clear a path for me through those vicious Webwood spiders...
narrative.requestItemsText: Oh... adventurer, I'm so glad you have returned.
